subQuests.subQuestName: Meet Jean and Venti at the Cathedral

3960201.text: This is Barbara, the Deaconess of the Church. She is here to retrieve the Holy Lyre der Himmel.

3960202.text: May the Anemo Archon protect you.

3960203.text: I'm not really in a position to speak compared to our Acting Grand Master...

3960204.text: But I still want to thank you all on behalf of all of Mondstadt for your assistance!

3960205.text: Fortunately, everything was resolved peacefully... I can't imagine how an all-out war between the military and the dragon would have ended...

3960206.text: Now the Fatui have no choice but to keep their mouths shut.

3960207.text: They must be annoyed that things didn't turn out as planned for them.

3960208.text: This time, they even lost their best excuse to pressure the Knights of Favonius.

3960209.text: Diplomatically speaking, they gained nothing, and on the contrary simply proved just how vexatious they can be.

3960210.text: Sounds like quite the story. So, did you bring the Holy Lyre with you?

3960211.text: We cannot ask you to keep defending the lyre forever. The Seneschal has been pressing me for a while now...

3960212.text: We ahh... did bring it with us... Ummm... It's just... it's a little...

3960213.text: Oh, don't worry! I'm not here to collect rent! The Church has always received special funding...

3960601.text: The wind amongst the branches is good, I love the way it smells...

3960602.text: Haha, I said the exact same thing the last time. *sigh* Why do I only say these things when I'm down on my luck?

3960605.text: *sigh* This isn't something I'm meant to discuss with ordinary people. But I suppose I can let you in on the secret.

3960606.text: As you know, Visions are external magical foci that only a small minority of people possess. They use these Visions to channel elemental power.

3960607.text: In truth, every wielder of a Vision is one who can attain godhood and ascend to Celestia. We call such people allogenes.

3960608.text: Allogenes? Paimon's never heard of them before.

3960609.text: Hehe, that's because this is a secret that only archons are privy to. We don't need primitive tools like Visions.

3960610.text: Instead, each archon has an internal magical focus that resonates directly with Celestia itself... known as a Gnosis.

3960611.text: What about the thing hanging off your hip?

3960612.text: Eh-he. It's just a glowing glass ball I carry around to avoid suspicion.

3960615.text: So who was that nasty woman who sent Paimon flying and stole your Gnosis?

3960616.text: Her name is Signora, No. 8 of the harbingers.

3960617.text: She and the rest of the harbingers have been given god-like executive authority by the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya, and with it, strength surpassing that of other mortals.

3960618.text: The Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya? Isn't that...

3960619.text: Indeed. She is one of The Seven, the Tsaritsa who reigns from the Zapolyarny Palace, and the one person that the Fatui Harbingers all answer to.

3960620.text: The Seven don't always get along well, but still — I never thought that she would plot to steal another archon's Gnosis...

3960621.text: What sort of god is the Tsaritsa?

3960622.text: Ah... How should I put this?

3960623.text: Five hundred years ago, I knew her well. But I can't say the same is true now.

3960624.text: You see, a certain catastrophe happened five hundred years ago, and after that, she cut off all ties with me.

3960625.text: But we can save discussion of the Cryo Archon and the Fatui for another day.

3960626.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you seek the rest of The Seven, many difficulties lie ahead of you still.

3960627.text: You should head for Mondstadt's neighboring nation of Liyue. The Geo Archon who reigns there, unlike me, administrates his entire region personally.

3960628.text: He only descends once every year to give his divine predictions, which set the direction for Liyue for the rest of that year.

3960629.text: Even so, it sounds like he works much harder than a certain someone.

3960631.text: ...In any case, this year's Rite of Descension is soon to begin. If you miss it, you'll just have to wait another year.

3960632.text: #WHAT!? Why didn't you tell us before? Well then bye. {NICKNAME}, we're going!

3960503.text: Um... I wouldn't say he's "alright," exactly.

3960504.text: I found you lying unconscious outside the Cathedral, and used my elemental powers to heal you...

3960510.text: That bard awakened first, but strangely, my healing powers had almost no effect on him...

3960511.text: This is the first time I've encountered such a patient. But he just said "it's completely normal," and then got up and left the Cathedral...

3960512.text: He left? Already? Where'd he go?

3960513.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>The Symbol of Mondstadt's Hero</color>, that's what he said.

3960514.text: I wanted to stop him, but Jean— I mean, Master Jean said to let him leave. How strange.

3960507.text: #Ah! Don't listen to {F#her}{M#his} nonsense, Miss Barbara!

3960508.text: Ahh... Um, okay, well basically, I found you lying outside the Cathedral, unconscious, and used my elemental powers to heal you...

3960509.text: Paimon thinks you could still use a final splash of ice-cold water to the face.

3960701.text: If you want to chat, now's the time — a bard stays not always in a single clime.

3960703.text: Up till the end, Dvalin remembered his duty as one of the Four Winds.

3960704.text: As such, I don't intend to forcibly strip him of that duty and force my ideals of freedom onto him.

3960705.text: I just hope that Dvalin will be able to choose for himself and understand what freedom is.

3960706.text: Before I became an archon, I too was taught the meaning of freedom in this way by a friend.

3960708.text: Kaeya shared some new intelligence, you say?

3960709.text: #...I see. So, the Abyss Order has a {F#Prince}{M#Princess} who orchestrated the plan to corrupt Dvalin?

3960710.text: #They were probably trying to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war for the Abyss. But that said, I have never heard of any such {F#Prince}{M#Princess} of the Abyss Order.

3960716.text: That Fatui lady didn't hang around, did she? She just grabbed your Gnosis and left!

3960717.text: She wanted to avoid any eyewitnesses from the Knights of Favonius.

3960718.text: The slightest slip-up here would have destroyed the Fatui's diplomatic relations with the Knights.

3960719.text: So they're just gonna keep acting like Mondstadt's allies as if nothing happened!?

3960720.text: *sigh*... If only the seven nations had banded together against the Abyss Order in the first place.

3960721.text: The Fatui possess the strongest military among the seven nations. Yet they've used it to steal the Holy Lyre, covet the power of gods, and use Dvalin as a bargaining chip against the Knights...

3960722.text: Speaking of the Lyre... didn't Diluc say something like this before?

3960723.text: He said that the Fatui can only run amok across the seven nations and threaten the Knights because of the harbingers.

3960724.text: Yes. As I said earlier, the Cryo Archon has given them authority and strength beyond that of other mortals.

3960725.text: The Tsaritsa... I haven't seen her in five hundred years. What is she thinking? What's her plan?

3960726.text: Whatever the answer is, I have a feeling it's only going to make your search for The Seven all the more difficult...

3960728.text: As I said before, Vision wielders are known as allogenes and may ascend to Celestia.

3960729.text: A Gnosis is a higher-order nexus of elemental manipulation and is emblematic of an archon's status as one of The Seven.

3960730.text: #But as for which of The Seven took your {F#brother}{M#sister}... I'm sorry, I don't know.

3960731.text: ...Wait, as one of the Seven, I'm not clear of suspicion yet either, am I?

3960742.text: Well then, best be off to <color=#00E1FFFF>Liyue</color>. If the descension ritual you fail to tally, then another year you must dally.

3960001.text: The Fatui were the ones who attacked you? That's too much...

3960002.text: Master Jean has already returned to the Knights Headquarters. She said that she will look for evidence.

3960003.text: But she also said that if no traces were left behind, the Knights might find it difficult to lodge a complaint against the culprit.
